work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission of the source-defined clean OpenBench M4.5 block from the committed raw run log. The unit is one harness aggregate over the same three harder partial-credit tasks with three trials each. Devin is not admitted because the primary source itself marks its rerun block unreliable after an adapter regression, hangs, intermittent no-attempt failure, and internally inconsistent token telemetry.

source_known_dimensions: same source-declared canonical gpt-5.5-medium model condition
same three harder partial-credit tasks at task revision 74c964e
same checker-based grading and partial-credit task semantics
same local execution mode on one macOS host in one run window
fresh temporary task workspace per cell
source records concrete harness versions and invocation commands
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: exact service-side model checkpoint behind the gpt-5.5/gpt-5.5-medium labels
independent proof that all client/provider routes resolved to an identical model snapshot
subscription/account routing and service-side state may differ by harness
exact upstream source revisions corresponding to the published package/build versions
client-native prompts, tool surfaces, context management and stopping behavior differ by design
ambient service-load effects are not independently controlled

non_admission_dispositions.reason: The primary source explicitly excludes Devin from the clean result: an invalid model-id regression was repaired, but the rerun still contained two 900-second hangs, one intermittent instant exit with no attempt, and roughly 20x token-count inconsistency on repeated instances. The source also states it cannot distinguish adapter from service instability. W1 preserves this as unreliable-source evidence rather than promoting it to a neutral clean observation.
These are separate committed evidence designs with different task surfaces and trial policies. They are not collapsed into the M4.5 observations and remain candidates for a distinct checkpoint.

results.note: Temporary write-enabled hook regenerated registry views, committed them on the PR branch, and then passed repository validation plus all four new record-specific admission checks.
